verdict.rationale: Docs assert the generated app is 'backed by editable code' and describe multiple paths to work with that code (Git sync to a local IDE, downloading the codebase, SQL editor for the database) but never explicitly document an in-builder source-code editor/view where a developer can open and directly edit files without leaving Lovable; most editing flows described route through chat prompts or external tools (IDE, GitHub). A community report also describes a signup flow with copy/paste disabled, raising doubt about how freely code can be manipulated directly in the builder UI. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-app code editor/view, independent hands-on confirmation that raw source files can be opened and edited within the builder itself (not just via chat, download, or Git sync).
